positions.title: Firmware Validation Engineering Intern
positions.description:
As a firmware validation engineering intern in the Battery Management System (BMS) team, my main tasks include:
- Test planning
- Programming and execution of tests in C
- Analyzing test results and validating new features for the BMS before release
- Schematic capture on Altium for tester and interface boards

positions.title: Software Quality Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
Responsible for maintaining the quality of embedded software for Enterprise Voice/Video over IP products throughout the development cycle. 

Managing automated test systems, analyzing test results, investigating failures, and designing automated test scripts and data post-analysis routines for a variety of features and systems.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Research Assistant
positions.description:
Worked at the Robotics for Rehabilitation, Exercise and Assessment in Collaborative Healthcare (RREACH) Lab for the Functional Engagement in Assisted Therapy Through Exercise Robotics (FEATHERS) project.

Contributed to a short paper titled “Kinecting the Moves: The kinematic potential of rehabilitation-specific gaming to inform treatment for hemiplegia” which won the Best Short Paper Award at the International Conference on Disability, Virtual Reality and Associated Technologies (ICDVRAT), in Gothenburg, Sweden.
